subject: Quickstart sign-up -> technical demo availability

From: Alex Rivera <alex.r@buildplay.com>
To: docs@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 14:50:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in a technical demo — embeddings & on-device inference

Hi Redwood team,

I tried the Quickstart flow this morning (nice work — fast setup!), and I wanted to request a short technical walkthrough. We're evaluating Redwood for two primary things:
- vector search/embeddings at ~500k vectors, low-latency queries (~25–50ms)
- options for private deployment (on-prem or VPC) because of our data controls

A quick agenda we'd like: sample prompt/embedding perf, model variant recommendations, and a short discussion of Dedicated vs Private options and integration patterns.

Preferred times (PT): Tue morning or Wed afternoon next week. We can be flexible about scope — a 30–45 minute deep-dive would be ideal.

Attached: quickstart-log.txt (brief console log from the trial).

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Staff Engineer, BuildPlay
alex.r@buildplay.com

- Tue 2026-05-26 10:00–10:45
- Tue 2026-05-26 14:00–14:45
- Wed 2026-05-27 11:00–11:45

Marissa, would you be able to lead the tech slot (embedding perf + model/infra options)? If useful we can do a short pre-call to align on the BuildPlay quickstart logs — I attached a screenshot from their trial console.

Alex — what level of depth do you want on the Private deployment side? High-level decision factors or a walkthrough of agent setup/credentials?

Attachments: quickstart-screenshot.png (UI capture).

For prep: our pilot dataset is ~450k embeddings, mostly short product description text; typical queries are 1–3 tokens for product code lookup and 12–30 tokens for relevance search. We don't need a deep on-prem tutorial — high-level Private vs Dedicated tradeoffs + any quick checklist for credentials and network setup is perfect.

Please send an invite and a calendar attachment. Looking forward to it.
